# Key facts
- **Focus keyword:** sewer smell in house (3,650/mo, KD 11). Supporting: house smells like sewer 1,480 (KD 19), sewer gas smell in house 1,000, bathroom smells like sewage 2,900, is sewer gas dangerous 1,600. Arizona-only volume unavailable.
- **SEO title:** Sewer Smell in House? What to Check This Fall in Arizona. Angle: homes reopening after summer and returning winter residents (dry P-traps).
- **Status:** published Sep 16 as post 18137 (per the handoff).
- **Next:** the Oct 1 content plan schedules a refresh to drop the "this fall" framing so it can rank year-round (sewer smell in bathroom 4,400 / KD 29).
